checks.note: All seven segments exist in en, es and zh-Hans, and the longest narration is 33.92 s (zh-Hans segment 6), under the 35 s ceiling; every other segment is shorter. Running times with the title card and pauses go to 36.32 s for that same zh-Hans segment, which the chapter list in guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png shows as 0:36 next to chapter 6 — inside the roughly 3 s the rubric allows, but it is the one segment that no longer reads as 'about 30 seconds' out loud.

The owl fact searched 18 files and found no match, and no mascot appears in any screenshot. What a patient sees in guide-en-desktop.png is the surgical site and anatomy: the mastoid head dressing, a hand pulling it off, the incision behind the ear with its closure strips, and a magnified ear panel labeled 'Check for tape'.

One narrator voice per language for all three narrated languages (voices fact: en, es and zh-Hans each a single voice, 'George'), and no character appears anywhere in the frame — the video pane holds numbered instruction panels and a title card (guide-from-link.png), not a talking figure. Voice quality itself is not something a screenshot can show; worth Song hearing the es and zh-Hans tracks, since all three languages use the same voice id.

Captions are present for segments 1-7 in en, es and zh-Hans. At desktop width the caption band sits under the video and is large and high-contrast (guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png, guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png); at phone width the transcript under the player carries the same text and highlights the spoken word (guide-en-phone.png highlights 'remove'). Nothing is clipped; the es caption band breaks its cue at a comma and the rest of the sentence is in the transcript. Minor: in zh-Hans the word highlight lands on part of a word ('乳' inside 乳突敷料 in guide-zh-Hans-phone.png), which does not affect readability.

All seven chapters are listed with titles and durations, visible without scrolling at 1280x800 in all three languages (guide-en-desktop.png sidebar), and at phone width as a 'Chapter 1 of 7' picker with prev/next above the transcript (guide-en-phone.png). Every chapter jump landed exactly on its expected start (0, 9.76, 30.56, 54.64, 68.08, 88.16, 114.56 s) with the right chapter marked active.

Switching language changes the whole page, not just the text: guide-es-desktop.png is Spanish end to end (title, 'Idioma', chapter titles, 'Reproducir', 'Subtítulos', 'Imprimir la tarjeta', call-for-help block) and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png is Simplified Chinese end to end. Audio follows — the es and zh-Hans audio files are tagged to those languages and each first sentence matches the expected translation — and the captions and transcript are in the chosen language. No stray English in either non-English screenshot.

Paste to link measured 607 ms, well under a minute, with two steps (paste the block, copy the link), zero account or login fields, and no network requests after load, so no app and no sign-in. 'What the guide will use' lists Antibiotic, Pain medication, Follow-up and Reviewed by (plus Language), each with a value and its source: presets when the block is the unfilled draft (provider-draft.png, 'From: preset'), and the provider's values when the block is filled in (provider-filled.png shows Antibiotic No, Pain medication Yes, Follow-up 2026-10-01, Español, Dr. Example 2026-09-19, all 'From: your block'). The draft's *** placeholder lines are not silently dropped — they appear under 'Lines we could not read' with their presets still applied.

It is one line in the block: 'Video guide: language {English/Spanish/Mandarin}    Reviewed by *** on ***'. Filled in, it reaches the patient guide as a clinician badge at the end of the transcript — 'Revisado por un profesional de la salud 19 de septiembre de 2026' in guide-from-link-badges.png, sitting next to the AI-translation and simulated-review badges, which also state plainly that this is not Song's approval.

The card is one tap away at both widths and the card itself returns 200. At desktop, 'Print the card' is in the header at top right (guide-en-desktop.png). At phone width it is still on the first screen, under the player controls and above the chapter picker ('Print the card' in guide-en-phone.png, 'Imprimir la tarjeta' in guide-es-phone.png, '打印卡片' in guide-zh-Hans-phone.png).
